description.p: spotDL finds songs from your Spotify playlists and downloads matching audio from YouTube, together with album art, lyrics and metadata.

ul.li: Download tracks, albums and playlists by pasting a Spotify link
Search for a song by name
Choose output format (MP3, FLAC, Opus, M4A, OGG, WAV) and bitrate

description.p: This application is a native GTK4 / libadwaita front-end for the spotDL command line tool. FFmpeg and Deno are bundled, so no additional dependencies are required.
Initial native GTK4 / libadwaita desktop GUI packaged as a Flatpak.
